messages:
adeel: Heads-up — staging doc previews are flapping on Chrome headless. Saw inconsistent codeblock rendering + missing anchor scroll. Repro steps below.
sophia: ack, can you paste the minimal repro? :eyes:
adeel: Repro:
1) open /docs/runtime/quickstart in staging
2) run chrome headless on default viewport
3) click "Usage examples" anchor
Observed: page jumps but code blocks for JSON snippets are empty ~50% of the time.
ryan: hmm, could be the mdx hydration or an intersection observer race. Any errors in console?
adeel: Console shows:
" 
Uncaught (in promise) TypeError: Cannot read property 'childNodes' of null
 at renderCodeBlock (runtime.bundle.js:2345)
" 
Also saw a 500 from the docs-renderer service intermittently.
sophia: I traced similar once — a frontmatter colon in the example title caused our mdx parser to emit an empty node. Patch is small: change the selector in renderCodeBlock to guard for null, and adjust the mdx-frontmatter regex.
adeel: I put a tiny PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/834 (WIP) — changes in site/components/CodeBlock.tsx and mdx/parseFrontmatter.js. Needs quick review + someone to claim staging smoke.
ryan: I'm on UX->can review CodeBlock.tsx in next 30m. @sophia can you own the mdx parse regex?
sophia: I can take parse. Quick note: tests failing locally on node 16, use node 18 for the test runner.
adeel: thx. Also adding a quick grep to find other potentially affected pages:
"
git grep -n \"title: .*:\\" docs | sed -n '1,50p'
"
planning to run a small script to auto-open PRs for pages that match.
docs-bot: deploy-preview created for PR #834 — preview URL: https://staging-previews.redwood.ai/pr-834
ryan: Reviewed CodeBlock.tsx — small nits, looks good. Approving. :thumbsup:
sophia: Working on parseFrontmatter.js now, will push by EOD. If anyone hits flapping in staging, add `?skip-hydrate=1` to preview to force non-hydrated render as a temporary workaround.
adeel: assigning owner for followups: @ryan (code), @sophia (mdx), @adeel (follow-up grep + smoke). Will run the grep and open PRs tonight.
ryan: I'll merge CodeBlock PR once CI passes. Tag me when parse PR is up so I can run integration.
sophia: pushed fix, PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/835 (link omitted)
adeel: thanks — noted. Anyone volunteer to sanity-check the staging preview after merge? 10-15m smoke test.
ryan: I can do it after merge.
sophia: done — tests passing locally. Will open PR.
adeel: Great — closing loop here. If owners see any odd pages, drop the path in thread.
